cars.summary: The second Scirocco’s GTX 16V brought the established Volkswagen sporting coupe into the four-valve era. Its 139 PS engine was accompanied by reinforced driveline and suspension parts and rear disc brakes, making it a substantive performance development of the Karmann-built coupe. One road reference represents this distinct Scirocco generation. Editorial driving assessment values its lively engine and entertaining, predictable chassis, while noting heavy steering and an ageing front end.

cars.generation: Original naturally aspirated Fiesta ST road family, Fiesta 2002 programme
cars.variant: ST 2.0 Duratec 150 PS — January 2005 German reference
cars.specification_market: January 2005 German production-road ST reference, before the later body update. Native 110 kW / 150 PS is retained. Source is a period Ford-attributed technical release preserved by an independent archive; it is not hosted on Ford’s current website. Optional 17-inch wheels are distinct from standard 16-inch wheels. Later turbo ST, Mountune, XR4 rebadges and cosmetic stripes do not add another record.
cars.summary: The original Fiesta ST was the first production model developed by Ford’s new TeamRS, bringing the fast-Fiesta lineage into the ST era. Its larger naturally aspirated Duratec, revised chassis, short-shift manual and rear disc brakes gave it a clear engineering identity. Contemporary driving praised its precise, agile handling and usable comfort.
